summary: The PR adds get/set_antialiased methods to Text objects and adjusts the backend to use these methods. The tests pass, but there are some concerns about maintainability and potential regressions.

issues.description: The change introduces new methods and modifies existing ones, which could affect maintainability. The code should include comments explaining the purpose of the new methods and how they interact with the existing code.

There is a risk of behavioral regression due to the change in how antialiasing is handled for Text objects. It should be verified that this change does not break any existing functionality or assumptions in other parts of the codebase.
